question_en: When the field through a ring rises uniformly from $0$ to $B$ in a time $t$, an EMF $\mathcal{E}$ is induced. What is the EMF if the field rises uniformly from $0$ to $2B$ in a time $\frac{t}{2}$?
question_uz: Halqa orqali maydon $t$ vaqtda $0$ dan $B$ gacha tekis ortganda halqada $\mathcal{E}$ EYK hosil bo'ladi. Maydon $\frac{t}{2}$ vaqtda $0$ dan $2B$ gacha tekis ortsa, EYK qancha bo'ladi?
question_ru: Когда поле через кольцо равномерно растёт от $0$ до $B$ за время $t$, в кольце возникает ЭДС $\mathcal{E}$. Какой будет ЭДС, если поле равномерно вырастет от $0$ до $2B$ за время $\frac{t}{2}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. EYK oqim o'zgarish tezligiga teng: o'zgarish 2 marta katta, vaqt 2 marta kichik — EYK 4 marta ortadi.
Asos: Faradey qonuni.

distractors.C: ikki o'zgarish bir-birini yo'qotadi deb olingan

distractors_en.A: only the change in field was counted
distractors_en.C: the two changes were assumed to cancel
distractors_en.E: multiplied by the time instead of dividing

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 13.3-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Pulling a rod along rails in a magnetic field at constant speed requires power $P$. What power is needed if the speed is increased by a factor of $2$?
question_uz: Maydondagi relslar bo'ylab sterjenni o'zgarmas tezlikda tortish uchun $P$ quvvat kerak. Tezlik $2$ marta oshirilsa, kerakli quvvat qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: Чтобы тянуть стержень по рельсам в магнитном поле с постоянной скоростью, нужна мощность $P$. Какая мощность нужна, если скорость увеличить в $2$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. EYK va tok v ga, tormozlovchi kuch ham v ga proporsional; quvvat P = Fv ∝ v² — 4 marta.
Asos: harakatdagi o'tkazgich EYK i.

distractors.B: quvvat tezlikka bog'liq emas deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: мощность считается не зависящей от скорости

distractors_en.A: the force was taken as constant
distractors_en.B: the power was assumed independent of speed

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», relslardagi sterjen g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A solenoid has inductance $L$. What is its inductance if the number of turns is increased by a factor of $2$ with the length and cross-section unchanged?
question_uz: Solenoid induktivligi $L$. Uzunligi va kesimi o'zgarmagan holda o'ramlar soni $2$ marta oshirilsa, induktivlik qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: Индуктивность соленоида равна $L$. Какой станет индуктивность, если число витков увеличить в $2$ раза при неизменных длине и сечении?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. N ikki marta ortsa, maydon ham, oqim bog'langan o'ramlar ham ikki marta ortadi: L ∝ N² — 4 marta.
Asos: solenoid induktivligi.

distractors.C: induktivlik faqat geometriyaga bog'liq deb o'ylangan

distractors_ru.C: считается, что зависит только от размеров

distractors_en.C: assumed to depend only on the dimensions

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.19-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: An RL circuit has inductance $2\ \mathrm{H}$ and resistance $4\ \Omega$. What is the time constant?
question_uz: RL zanjirda induktivlik $2\ \mathrm{H}$, qarshilik $4\ \Omega$. Vaqt doimiysi nimaga teng?
question_ru: В RL-цепи индуктивность $2\ \mathrm{H}$, сопротивление $4\ \Omega$. Чему равна постоянная времени?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. τ = L/R = 2/4 = 0.5 s; o'lchamlar: H/Ω = s.
Asos: RL zanjir vaqt doimiysi.

distractors_en.E: the resistance was taken as the time constant

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.43-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The natural angular frequency of an LC circuit is $\omega_0$. What does it become if the capacitance is increased by a factor of $4$?
question_uz: LC konturning xususiy burchak chastotasi $\omega_0$. Kondensator sig'imi $4$ marta oshirilsa, chastota qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: Собственная угловая частота LC-контура равна $\omega_0$. Какой станет частота, если ёмкость конденсатора увеличить в $4$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. ω₀ = 1/√(LC) ∝ 1/√C; C to'rt marta ortsa, chastota ikki marta kamayadi.
Asos: Tomson formulasi.

distractors.C: chastota sig'imga bog'liq emas deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: частота считается не зависящей от ёмкости

distractors_en.C: the frequency was taken as independent of C

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.59-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A current of $3\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a coil of inductance $2\ \mathrm{H}$. What is the energy of its magnetic field?
question_uz: Induktivligi $2\ \mathrm{H}$ bo'lgan g'altakdan $3\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Uning magnit maydon energiyasi qancha?
question_ru: По катушке индуктивностью $2\ \mathrm{H}$ течёт ток $3\ \mathrm{A}$. Какова энергия её магнитного поля?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. W = LI²/2 = 2·9/2 = 9 J.
Asos: magnit energiya.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.31-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A rod of length $l$ is pulled along rails at constant speed $v$ in a field $B$; the circuit resistance is $R$. What external force is needed?
question_uz: Uzunligi $l$ bo'lgan sterjen $B$ maydonda relslar bo'ylab o'zgarmas $v$ tezlik bilan tortilmoqda; zanjir qarshiligi $R$. Qanday tashqi kuch kerak?
question_ru: Стержень длиной $l$ тянут по рельсам в поле $B$ с постоянной скоростью $v$; сопротивление цепи $R$. Какая нужна внешняя сила?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Tok I = Blv/R, Amper kuchi F = IlB = B²l²v/R; o'zgarmas tezlikda tashqi kuch unga teng.
Asos: Amper kuchi.

distractors_en.A: the current was confused with the force

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 13.27-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A conducting rod of length $l$ rotates about one end with angular speed $\omega$ in a field $B$ perpendicular to the plane of rotation. What is the EMF between its ends?
question_uz: Uzunligi $l$ bo'lgan o'tkazuvchi sterjen bir uchi atrofida $\omega$ burchak tezlik bilan aylanish tekisligiga tik $B$ maydonda aylanmoqda. Uchlari orasidagi EYK nimaga teng?
question_ru: Проводящий стержень длиной $l$ вращается вокруг одного конца с угловой скоростью $\omega$ в поле $B$, перпендикулярном плоскости вращения. Чему равна ЭДС между концами?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Har bo'lak tezligi ωr; dε = Bωr·dr, 0 dan l gacha integral — Bωl²/2 (o'rtacha tezlik ωl/2).
Asos: aylanayotgan sterjen.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 13.33-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The field inside a long solenoid of radius $R$ changes at the rate $\frac{dB}{dt}=k$. What is the induced electric field a distance $2R$ from the axis?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan uzun solenoid ichidagi maydon $\frac{dB}{dt}=k$ tezlik bilan o'zgarmoqda. O'qdan $2R$ masofada uyurmali elektr maydon kuchlanganligi nimaga teng?
question_ru: Поле внутри длинного соленоида радиуса $R$ меняется со скоростью $\frac{dB}{dt}=k$. Чему равна напряжённость вихревого электрического поля на расстоянии $2R$ от оси?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. E·2π(2R) = πR²k: tashqarida faqat solenoid kesimi orqali oqim o'zgaradi, E = Rk/4.
Asos: uyurmali elektr maydon.

en: A circle of radius $2R$: $$E\cdot2\pi\cdot2R=\pi R^2k\ \Rightarrow\ E=\frac{Rk}{4}$$

distractors.C: B = 0 bo'lgani uchun E = 0 deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the inside formula was used at r = 2R
distractors_en.C: E = 0 was assumed because B = 0 there

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 13.51-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: When the current in coil 1 changes at $2\ \mathrm{A/s}$, an EMF of $6\ \mathrm{mV}$ appears in coil 2. What EMF appears in coil 1 when the current in coil 2 changes at $4\ \mathrm{A/s}$ (in $\mathrm{mV}$)?
question_uz: Birinchi g'altakdagi tok $2\ \mathrm{A/s}$ tezlik bilan o'zgarganda ikkinchi g'altakda $6\ \mathrm{mV}$ EYK hosil bo'ladi. Ikkinchi g'altakdagi tok $4\ \mathrm{A/s}$ tezlik bilan o'zgarsa, birinchi g'altakda qanday EYK hosil bo'ladi ($\mathrm{mV}$)?
question_ru: Когда ток в первой катушке меняется со скоростью $2\ \mathrm{A/s}$, во второй возникает ЭДС $6\ \mathrm{mV}$. Какая ЭДС возникнет в первой катушке, если ток во второй меняется со скоростью $4\ \mathrm{A/s}$ (в $\mathrm{mV}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. M = 6 mV / 2 A/s = 3 mH; M₁₂ = M₂₁, shuning uchun ε₁ = M·4 = 12 mV.
Asos: o'zaro induktivlik.

distractors_en.A: the rate of change was ignored
distractors_en.B: the ratio of rates was inverted

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», o'zaro induktivlik g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The magnetic flux through a ring of resistance $R$ changes from $\Phi$ to $-\Phi$. How much charge flows around the ring?
question_uz: Qarshiligi $R$ bo'lgan halqa orqali magnit oqimi $\Phi$ dan $-\Phi$ gacha o'zgardi. Halqadan qancha zaryad o'tadi?
question_ru: Магнитный поток через кольцо сопротивлением $R$ изменился от $\Phi$ до $-\Phi$. Какой заряд прошёл по кольцу?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. q = |ΔΦ|/R, o'zgarish Φ − (−Φ) = 2Φ; zaryad tezlikka bog'liq emas.
Asos: induksion zaryad.

distractors.C: oxirgi va boshlang'ich oqim moduli teng — o'zgarish yo'q deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: модули равны — сочтено, что изменения нет

distractors_en.A: the change was taken as Φ
distractors_en.C: equal magnitudes were taken to mean no change

source: Volkenshteyn, «Problems in General Physics», 11.31-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is the energy density of a magnetic field of strength $B$?
question_uz: Induksiyasi $B$ bo'lgan magnit maydon energiyasining hajmiy zichligi nimaga teng?
question_ru: Чему равна объёмная плотность энергии магнитного поля с индукцией $B$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Solenoid uchun W = LI²/2 = (B²/2μ₀)·V; zichlik w = B²/(2μ₀).
Asos: magnit energiya zichligi.

distractors.B: elektr maydon ε₀E²/2 kabi μ₀ suratga qo'yilgan

distractors_ru.B: μ₀ поставлено в числитель, как ε₀ в ε₀E²/2

distractors_en.B: μ₀ was put in the numerator like ε₀ in ε₀E²/2

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.33-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The figure shows the current $I(t)$ after a switch is closed in a circuit with a $6\ \Omega$ resistor and a coil in series. What is the coil's inductance (in $\mathrm{mH}$)?
question_uz: Rasmda $6\ \Omega$ rezistor va g'altak ketma-ket ulangan zanjirda kalit ulangandan keyingi tokning $I(t)$ grafigi berilgan. G'altak induktivligi qancha ($\mathrm{mH}$)?
question_ru: На рисунке дан график тока $I(t)$ после замыкания ключа в цепи из последовательно соединённых резистора $6\ \Omega$ и катушки. Какова индуктивность катушки (в $\mathrm{mH}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Tok oxirgi qiymat 2 A ning 63 foiziga (1.26 A) t = 5 ms da yetadi: τ = 5 ms, L = Rτ = 6·5 = 30 mH.
Asos: RL zanjir.

distractors_en.D: milliseconds and seconds were mixed up
distractors_en.E: the final current was used instead of τ

source: original (B2-L17, I(t) grafigi)

question_en: The largest charge on the capacitor in an LC circuit is $q$. What is the largest current in the circuit?
question_uz: LC konturda kondensatorning eng katta zaryadi $q$. Konturdagi eng katta tok nimaga teng?
question_ru: Наибольший заряд конденсатора в LC-контуре равен $q$. Чему равен наибольший ток в контуре?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Energiya saqlanishi: q²/(2C) = LI²/2, demak I = q/√(LC) = ω₀q.
Asos: LC energiyasi.

distractors.E: kuchlanishdan tokka o'tish formulasi zaryadga qo'llangan

distractors_ru.E: формула для напряжения применена к заряду

distractors_en.E: the voltage-to-current formula was applied to charge

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.57-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Two uncoupled coils of inductance $L$ and $3L$ are connected in parallel. What is the total inductance?
question_uz: Induktivliklari $L$ va $3L$ bo'lgan, o'zaro bog'lanmagan ikki g'altak parallel ulangan. Umumiy induktivlik nimaga teng?
question_ru: Две несвязанные катушки с индуктивностями $L$ и $3L$ соединены параллельно. Чему равна общая индуктивность?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Parallel ulashda kuchlanish umumiy, toklar qo'shiladi: 1/L = 1/L + 1/(3L), natija 3L/4.
Asos: g'altaklarni ulash.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.25-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Coils of $4\ \mathrm{mH}$ and $9\ \mathrm{mH}$ are fully coupled ($k=1$) and connected in series so that their fluxes add. What is the total inductance (in $\mathrm{mH}$)?
question_uz: Induktivliklari $4\ \mathrm{mH}$ va $9\ \mathrm{mH}$ bo'lgan g'altaklar to'liq bog'langan ($k=1$) va oqimlari qo'shiladigan qilib ketma-ket ulangan. Umumiy induktivlik qancha ($\mathrm{mH}$)?
question_ru: Катушки с индуктивностями $4\ \mathrm{mH}$ и $9\ \mathrm{mH}$ связаны полностью ($k=1$) и соединены последовательно так, что их потоки складываются. Какова общая индуктивность (в $\mathrm{mH}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. M = √(4·9) = 6 mH; oqimlar qo'shilsa L = L₁ + L₂ + 2M = 4 + 9 + 12 = 25 mH.
Asos: bog'langan g'altaklar.

distractors_en.C: the fluxes were taken as opposing

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», bog'langan g'altaklar g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A source of EMF $\mathcal{E}$, a resistor and a coil are connected in series. What is the voltage across the coil just after the switch is closed?
question_uz: EYK i $\mathcal{E}$ bo'lgan manba, rezistor va g'altak ketma-ket ulangan. Kalit ulangan zahoti g'altakdagi kuchlanish nimaga teng?
question_ru: Источник с ЭДС $\mathcal{E}$, резистор и катушка соединены последовательно. Чему равно напряжение на катушке сразу после замыкания ключа?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. G'altakdagi tok sakrab o'zgara olmaydi: t = 0⁺ da I = 0, rezistorda kuchlanish yo'q — butun EYK g'altakda.
Asos: RL zanjir.

distractors_en.A: the steady state was used (coil as a wire)
distractors_en.D: confused with the spike on opening

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 14.41-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A charged capacitor is connected to a coil at $t=0$; the oscillation period is $T$. When are the electric and magnetic energies first equal?
question_uz: Zaryadlangan kondensator $t=0$ da g'altakka ulandi; tebranish davri $T$. Elektr va magnit energiyalar birinchi marta qachon tenglashadi?
question_ru: Заряженный конденсатор в момент $t=0$ подключили к катушке; период колебаний $T$. Когда электрическая и магнитная энергии впервые станут равными?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. q = q₀cos ω₀t; energiyalar teng bo'lishi uchun cos² = sin², ya'ni ω₀t = π/4, t = T/8.
Asos: LC energiyasi.

distractors.B: barcha energiya magnit bo'lgan payt olingan
distractors.C: energiya yana elektr bo'lgan payt olingan

distractors_ru.B: взят момент, когда вся энергия магнитная
distractors_ru.C: взят момент, когда энергия снова электрическая
distractors_ru.D: взят момент, когда заряд падает вдвое

distractors_en.B: the moment all the energy is magnetic
distractors_en.C: the moment the energy is electric again

source: original (B2-L17, LC energiyasi)

question_en: Which is the differential form of Faraday's law?
question_uz: Faradey qonunining differensial ko'rinishi qaysi?
question_ru: Какова дифференциальная форма закона Фарадея?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. ∮E·dl = −dΦ/dt ga Stoks teoremasini qo'llasak, rot E = −∂B/∂t; elektr maydon uyurmali.
Asos: Faradey qonuni.

uz: Stoks teoremasi: $$\oint\vec E\cdot d\vec l=\int\left(\nabla\times\vec E\right)\cdot d\vec A=-\int\frac{\partial\vec B}{\partial t}\cdot d\vec A$$
ru: Теорема Стокса: $$\oint\vec E\cdot d\vec l=\int\left(\nabla\times\vec E\right)\cdot d\vec A=-\int\frac{\partial\vec B}{\partial t}\cdot d\vec A$$
en: Stokes' theorem: $$\oint\vec E\cdot d\vec l=\int\left(\nabla\times\vec E\right)\cdot d\vec A=-\int\frac{\partial\vec B}{\partial t}\cdot d\vec A$$

distractors_en.E: divergence with E and B swapped

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», Maksvell tenglamalari g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A loop of $N$ turns and area $A$ rotates in a field $B$ about an axis perpendicular to the field, making $f$ revolutions per second. What is the amplitude of the EMF?
question_uz: $N$ o'ramli, yuzasi $A$ bo'lgan ramka $B$ maydonda maydonga tik o'q atrofida sekundiga $f$ marta aylanmoqda. EYK amplitudasi nimaga teng?
question_ru: Рамка из $N$ витков площадью $A$ вращается в поле $B$ вокруг оси, перпендикулярной полю, делая $f$ оборотов в секунду. Чему равна амплитуда ЭДС?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Φ = BA cos ωt, ε = NBAω sin ωt, ω = 2πf: amplituda 2πfNBA.
Asos: generator EYK i.

distractors_en.A: f was used instead of ω

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 13.43-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan
